name: c_rows
what: the eight rows build; calibrated rows depend on the draw, the others do not; own requests are candidates; undefined rows are refused with their reason

undefined.where_logonly: DEFINED, outside the eight rows: ReScope-W is registered for E10 by amendment R14 with log-only and with two-block thresholds; built here as the rows where_logonly / where_twoblock (e10t.methods.ROWSET_R14).
undefined.cosine_shared: DEFINED, not registered for E10: e10t.methods.cosine(L, 'shared').
undefined.cosine_default: UNDEFINED: the retrofit of the cosine gate to the write position (0.65 at role 'last') needs a marked position; ROME writes at the last subject token, which a served prompt does not mark.  Its all-positions form is the row cosine_published.
undefined.ball: NOT REGISTERED for E10: the GRACE-style gate queries the final prompt token by definition, where a subject-token key of these logs is never presented, so its published form cannot release anything here; an all-positions retrofit is constructible (e10t.methods.scoped(L, 'ball', feature='negdist')) but is not in the registered row list and was not built or run.
undefined.ball_default: UNDEFINED in its published form (radius 1.0 at the final prompt token): as ball.
undefined.router: UNDEFINED as defined: the WISE-style router decides at the last prompt position and serves the deployed output from there on (role 'last+answer'); these logs write at the last subject token, before that position, so a routed query would not receive its edit.
undefined.zscore: DEFINABLE (the z-score gate looks at every position and needs the deployed weight), not in the registered row list of E10; not built.
undefined.zscore_default: DEFINABLE, not in the registered row list of E10; not built.
undefined.dual: DEFINABLE (answer match: two decodes per query); cut on unseen logs by amendment R19 (6); not built.
undefined.p12_comp_b_nall: UNDEFINED: the linear repairs of P12 (COMP-B, REEDIT-B, RB-UNION, RB-TOT) are corrections that the vision-language harness (07_repair_v3) built from its complaint sets; neither the harness nor the saved corrections exist for a text log.  Their text counterparts (comp_min, rb_suffix, rb_lineage, blocklist) are registered separately by R14 and enter through e10t.methods.weight.
